frost_caves_depth.generation_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: independently scrolling depth layer for a claustrophobic side-scrolling game interior
Primary request: Narrow frost cave
Materials: Compact glacial tunnel enclosed by layered opaque blue ice and dark frozen stone. Readable ice fractures and trapped cloudy bands. Ceiling: a low solid ice shelf with short attached icicles, compressed snow seams and no view of an open sky.
Composition: Opaque distant recess layer only. A close horizontal band of dark shallow recesses in an enclosed passage, interrupted by dim silhouettes of distant supports. Subtle atmospheric depth and a narrow value range. No enormous chamber, vertical abyss, soaring pillars or receding corridor. No foreground ceiling, floor, nearby wall piers, props or characters. Fill the entire image; any visible recess has an enclosed back.
Camera: strict orthographic side view along a horizontal tunnel, parallel to the image plane. The passage continues sideways off both edges.
Style/medium: Weathered dark fantasy pixel art. Broad readable shapes, deliberate stepped color clusters, restrained outlines and a small muted palette. Material identity comes from silhouette and a few grouped marks. Refined material edges and deliberate fine pixel clusters at the Wetlands texture density. Keep local contrast restrained behind actors; distant layers use a narrower value range. Preserve full texture resolution independently of the logical layout. Do not enlarge a coarse pixel grid to create quiet scenery.
Color palette: Desaturated steel blue, slate, dark indigo and restrained cloudy ice blue; sparse pale cyan edge accents.
Lighting: Muted diffuse blue light carried through cloudy ice, dark seams and no sparkling bloom.
Canvas: 640 by 360 logical units; generate a large image with width at least 1536 pixels and this aspect ratio.
Opacity: completely opaque edge-to-edge image.
If a reference image is supplied, use it for pixel texture density and restrained shading only; keep the requested indoor subject and enclosed composition.
Avoid: photorealism, intricate microtexture, dense cracks or hatching, single-pixel speckle, dithering, dramatic spotlights, bloom, soft airbrushed edges, text, watermarks, UI, painted checkerboard, isometric or overhead view, a road receding to a vanishing point, tiny-resolution upscaling, flat featureless polygons, harsh white highlights, vast cave expanses, soaring ceilings, long vanishing-point corridors, characters
